description: Wavetable oscillator with 16 banks of 16 waves, a bit crusher, a sub oscillator on its own jack, and one CV input whose destination is picked from the menu

params.text: Steps to the next wavetable bank, with four lamps showing the bank number in binary
Switches the FREQUENCY knob between a coarse and a fine setting of the pitch, each position keeping its own setting
Attenuates the CV IN input before it reaches the destination picked on the menu
Attenuates the WAVE CV input before it moves the wave selection
Reduces the bit resolution of the output, turned up for a coarser and grittier signal
Picks one of the 16 waves in the bank, morphing between two neighbouring waves at settings between them
Sets the pitch, coarsely or finely according to the COARSE switch
Picks one of three waves for the sub oscillator

inputs.text: Carries the CV for the destination picked on the menu, which is the bit crusher, the bank number, the frequency or the built-in VCA, scaled by the CV LEVEL knob
Moves the wave selection through the bank, scaled by the WAVE CV knob
Pitch input tracking one volt per octave, added to the pitch set by the FREQUENCY knob

outputs.text: The oscillator output, which the bit crusher and the built-in VCA both act on
The sub oscillator output, carrying the wave picked by the SUB switch

menu: CV to Crush — the CV IN jack drives the bit crusher
CV to Bank — the CV IN jack picks the wavetable bank
CV to FM — the CV IN jack modulates the frequency
CV to VCA — the CV IN jack drives the built-in VCA on the main output
